haikus.haiku:
Creamy swirl of joy
Sweet vanilla scent drifts soft
Golden crust sighs warm
Happy #NationalBavarianCreamPieDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Blue waves hum below
Electric pulses glow bright
Night river sings soft
Happy #ElectricEelDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Strum of neon light
Sparks dance on summer bright air
Guitar sighs, moon laughs
#HappyBirthdayJimiHendrix from @ClamBakeSanta

Firefly glow on night
Moonlight drips like silver rain
Joy leaps in bright air
#HappyBirthdayBruceLee from @ClamBakeSanta
